LanguageData.Bloodfeed.description: Wardens will ignore this prisoner. When a vampire's blood levels are low, they may feed on this prisoner. Other prisoners who are vampires can also feed on this prisoner, if they are in the same cell.
LanguageData.HemogenFarm.description: An operation to extract blood packs will be automatically queued on this prisoner whenever it can be done without killing them. The operation will be carried out by a doctor.
LanguageData.HemogenFarm.label: blood farm
